title: Cedar Gap & Youngsport Country Loop
summary: A country ride from Liberty Hill through Youngsport and Stillman Valley, with a stop at Cedar Gap Park.
body_markdown: Cedar Gap Park is a free lakeside stop with parking and a restroom. Its access road is a short out-and-back off FM 3481.

sources.title: Google Maps itinerary supplied by the rider
US Army Corps of Engineers: Cedar Gap Park facilities and free access

author_note.text:
I found this an easy ride, mostly on country roads with light traffic and good pavement. There are enough curves to keep me interested, but I didn’t find it especially challenging. It suits the kind of riding I enjoy: taking my time and riding through the country.

Cedar Gap is my stop to stretch my legs, take a few pictures, and use the restroom.

waypoints: Stillman Valley Road near Peaceable Kingdom Road
via: US 183 -> TX 138 -> TX 195 -> Chaparral Rd -> FM 3481 -> Cedar Gap Park -> FM 3481 -> FM 2484 -> Stillman Valley Rd -> CR 228 -> TX 138 -> US 183

stops.note: Free lakeside stop with parking, lake views, and a restroom; short out-and-back park access road.
